subject: FintechCo — follow-up: pricing + US vs EU residency
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: James Holt <j.holt@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pricing + US vs EU residency (post-call recap)

Hi James — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and a couple follow-ups so we can get a tailored quote across the finish line:

Recap:
- Expected traffic: ~15M tokens/month (mix of prompts + completions), peak ~180–220 RPS for interactive features.
- Primary requirement: EU data residency for EU customers; US region OK for US customers.
- Target procurement window: decision in ~3–4 weeks pending pricing and legal review.

Open items for pricing/qualification:
1) Can you confirm the 15M tokens/month estimate is an average sustained run-rate vs a short-term pilot spike? If it's a sustained run-rate, do you expect growth of ~20–30% over 12 months?
2) Budget range — you mentioned rough target spend of $5k–$8k/month on inference. Is that still the right target? If so, what's the preferred target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for?
3) Residency split — do you expect ~100% EU traffic for regulated customers (so we should price EU-only hosting), or will there be a split (e.g., 60% EU / 40% US)?

Next steps (what I'll do):
- I attached a small pricing template (Redwood_pricing_template.xlsx) — can you fill the "expected monthly tokens by region" row? That will let us generate 3 options: Hosted US, Hosted EU (region premium), and Dedicated/Committed capacity with discounts.
- Once you confirm volumes + target $/1M tokens, I'll route to Marissa for commercial and Sean for capacity planning.

Thanks — Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0197

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: James Holt <j.holt@fintechco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing + US vs EU residency (post-call recap)

Thanks for the recap, Dylan — really helpful. A few answers below:

1) Volume: 15M tokens/month is our expected steady-state for Q3 (post-pilot). We do expect ~25% growth over 12 months as we expand to more enterprise customers.
2) Budget: our procurement/finance target for initial year is $6k–$9k/month for inference. We discussed aiming for a unit economics target in the ballpark of $350–600 per 1M tokens depending on SLA and residency.
3) Residency: For regulated EU customers we require EU-only processing and data residency. For our non-regulated US customers we are fine with US hosting. Roughly we expect 65% EU traffic / 35% US traffic initially.

Attached: FintechCo_Security_Questionnaire.pdf — procurement asked we start the security questionnaire in parallel.

Can you return a small price-band table (Hosted US / Hosted EU / Dedicated committed) that shows $/1M token and estimated monthly spend for our 15M baseline? That will help us compare before the next procurement sync.

Appreciate it — James
